name: NMS
desc: An NMS (Network Management System) provides centralized visibility and control of network devices, enabling real-time monitoring of device health, performance, configuration, firmware, and connectivity. It supports remote configuration, auto-provisioning, alerts, analytics, secure access, and scalable management of large device networks.
use_cases: Remote Monitoring for EV Charging Stations

additional_specs.v: View health, performance, and status of all routers  on a single dashboard.
Push updates, modify settings, and change  firmware remotely.
Automatically configure new routers when added  to the network.
HTTPS, VPN, SSH, and encrypted communication.
Monitor uptime, signal strength, bandwidth usage,  and connected clients.
Receive alerts for device disconnection, high  usage, or firmware failure.
Responsive UI, Role-Based Access, Device Grouping
